data.one_liner: Synchronizes a scrollable list of grouped items with corresponding navigation tabs.
data.what_it_does: Provides a customizable Flutter widget that synchronizes a scrollable list with tabs. The tabs automatically follow the active scroll index and clicking a tab scrolls the list to the relevant group.
use_when: You need a settings page or catalog where scrolling updates a category tab bar
You want tab selection to automatically scroll a grouped list to the correct section
avoid_when: You need a standard non-scrolling tab bar interface
You do not have grouped list items that map to distinct tabs
strengths: Two-way synchronization between tabs and list scroll position
Supports custom builders for items, tabs, and headers
weaknesses: Limited documentation outside of basic README examples
Relies on external packages for positioning logic
data.minimal_example:
ScrollableListTabScroller(
  itemCount: data.length,
  tabBuilder: (BuildContext context, int index, bool active) => Text(data.keys.elementAt(index)),
  itemBuilder: (BuildContext context, int index) => Text(data.values.elementAt(index).toString()),
)
